name: Fina
bio: A young spellcaster who manipulates light and ice, built around one idea: keep the buffs running and make everyone's weapon attacks hit harder. One of the game's best offensive supports, with book-based attacks that grant consistent crowd control.

skills.name: "On a Warm Afternoon"
skills.desc: Deals Lumino Damage to enemies within range and decreases their Movement Speed. When using this skill in [Boisterous Tea Party], the damage is increased, and the damage range is expanded to the same range of [Boisterous Tea Party].

skills.name: "Let the Tea Party Begin!"
skills.desc: Creates a [Boisterous Tea Party] field in front of Fina. [Boisterous Tea Party] continuously consumes Sanity and ends when Sanity drops to 0 or when this skill is long pressed. During [Boisterous Tea Party], using the skill again will switch the field effects in the order of the [Tea Party Guests]: [Nightingale], [Hound], [Unicorn], and [Butterfly]. Using the skill again outside the range of [Boisterous Tea Party] will relocate it to Fina's current location.

skills.name: "Bad Sorcerers Hate Sunlight!"
skills.desc: Fina gains the ability to deal additional Lumino Damage throughout the battle. When using ["On a Warm Afternoon"], gains 3 stacks of [Taleweaver Quill]. During [Boisterous Tea Party], gains 1 stack of [Taleweaver Quill] per second, up to 30 stacks.

skills.name: "To Be Continued"
skills.desc: When using ["On a Warm Afternoon"], increases the CRIT Chance of Fina's and her nearby teammates' weapon attack based on the number of [Taleweaver Quill] stacks gained.

skills.name: "Advance, Poker Card Soldiers!"
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases Weapon DMG for the character and their nearby teammates mastering in Sword or Assault Rifle.
